title: Riding to the Lake
lines: Kate was riding her bike to a lake.
The sun was shining on the road.
A cat came sliding out from a shed.
Kate was taking a big turn.
She was smiling. Then she was not.
The bike slid, but Kate saved it.
Kate was smiling all the way home.

questions.listenFor: The lake. First line - a quick win to start with.

questions.ask: What came out from the shed?
questions.listenFor: A cat, sliding. If they say dog, have them go back and look.

questions.ask: Why do you think Kate stopped smiling for a bit?
questions.listenFor: Any sensible reason - the cat, the turn, nearly falling. You want them to link two lines together.
